# Visual Studio Code Documentation

> > Official documentation for Visual Studio Code, covering editor features, GitHub Copilot integration, language support, extensions, and development containers.

Visual Studio Code is Microsoft's free, open-source code editor with support for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and many other languages. The documentation covers core editing features, IntelliSense code completion, GitHub Copilot AI assistance, remote development with Docker containers, and the extensive VS Code extension API.

## Key Topics

- Visual Studio Code
- GitHub Copilot
- IntelliSense
- Copilot agents
- Dev containers
- JavaScript and TypeScript
- Python development
- Extension API
- Code editing and completion
- Docker integration
- MCP servers
- Profiles and customization
- Language support
- Interactive coding
- Remote development

## Getting Started and Core Features

- [Basic editing](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editing/codebasics): Basic editing features: search, multi-cursor, and code formatting
- [Programming Languages](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/overview): Overview of language support with IntelliSense and GitHub Copilot
- [Productivity Tips](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/introvideos/productivity): VS Code productivity tips with shortcuts, multi-cursor, and terminal tricks
- [Profiles in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/profiles): Configure and manage VS Code profiles for customized settings and workflows
- [Download Visual Studio Code Insiders](https://code.visualstudio.com/insiders): Download VS Code Insiders for early access to nightly builds and features

## GitHub Copilot and AI Agents

- [Using agents in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/agents/overview): Overview of AI agents including local, cloud, and Copilot CLI agents
- [Tutorial: Work with agents in VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/agents/agents-tutorial): Tutorial for using local, background, and cloud agents with GitHub Copilot
- [Agent plugins in VS Code (Preview)](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/customization/agent-plugins): Install and manage GitHub Copilot agent plugins with MCP server support
- [Third-party agents in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/agents/third-party-agents): Use third-party agents like Claude and OpenAI with GitHub Copilot
- [Memory in VS Code agents](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/agents/memory): How Copilot agents use memory to retain context across conversations

## Language-Specific Development

- [Editing Python in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/python/editing): Python editing with IntelliSense, Pylance, and autocomplete features
- [Java extensions for Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/java/extensions): Java Extension Pack and popular extensions for Java development
- [CSS, SCSS and Less](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/css): CSS, SCSS, and Less support with IntelliSense, color preview, and Emmet
- [Data Science in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/datascience/overview): Data science with Jupyter Notebooks, Python, and machine learning tools

## Extension API Reference

- [Contribution Points | Visual Studio Code Extension API](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/contribution-points): Extension API reference for package.json contribution points

## Development Containers and Remote Development

- [Use Docker or Kubernetes from a container](https://code.visualstudio.com/remote/advancedcontainers/use-docker-kubernetes): Access Docker and Kubernetes from dev containers with socket mounting
- [Develop on a remote Docker host](https://code.visualstudio.com/remote/advancedcontainers/develop-remote-host): Connect to remote Docker hosts via SSH or tunnels for dev containers
- [Add another local file mount](https://code.visualstudio.com/remote/advancedcontainers/add-local-file-mount): Add local file mounts to dev containers with Docker and Docker Compose

## Reference Documentation

- [Glob Patterns Reference](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns): Reference guide for glob pattern syntax in file matching and search
- [Language Identifiers](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/identifiers): Reference list of language mode identifiers for VS Code configuration
